text:
June (Sales): folks, Verdant Health sent their RFI this morning. main asks: capability matrix (feature vs competitor), POC timeline for a hybrid private+dedicated setup, pricing for 3 POC tiers, KMS/HSM support details, quantization/FP16 guidance, and a short list of artifacts we can attach. can someone own a consolidated reply?

Ben (Solutions Eng): I can draft the capability matrix and a short POC plan. will need answers from product on quantization and from infra on KMS.

Maria (Product): quick notes: we support int8/4bit quantization on Dedicated and Private with our q-formats. for hosted, we only expose verified quantized variants (no customer-side quantization). FP16 is supported for the Llama-family variants; guidance: expect ~1.6x perf improvement vs FP32 depending on sequence length. i'll write 3 bullets to copy into the RFI.

Rahul (SRE): KMS/HSM: Private (VPC) can integrate with customer KMS (CloudKMS/Azure Key Vault) via our control plane proxy; for on-prem we support HSM+PKCS#11 — needs a short ops checklist (network, firewall rules, NTP). Dedicated (Redwood-managed) offers envelope encryption and can integrate customer KMS for key wrapping — but we don't store raw customer keys. i'll attach the checklist. @Ben — do you need a diagram for the RFI?

Ben (Solutions Eng): yes a small network diagram would help. i'll add: expected ports, peering, and recommended MTU. also need a short performance table (tokens/sec) for small/medium/large models on our Dedicated SKU. i have a perf CSV from last month i can attach.

June (Sales): thanks — also they asked for POC milestones: baseline eval, integration sprint, go/no-go. propose 4-week POC with optional week 5 for tuning. pricing: give them three bands (dev sandbox free/month, 4-week POC discounted commit, 3-month pilot at reduced reserved rate). someone draft clear numbers we can send to procurement.

Maria (Product): draft POC outline I recommend:
- Week 0: onboarding, creds, baseline prompts + eval set
- Week 1: smoke tests + integration (routing + auth)
- Week 2: perf runs + KV/prefix caching tuning
- Week 3: quality review + cost/perf tradeoff recommendations
- Week 4: handoff + runbook + optional canary
I can write the sample eval snippet and baseline metrics.

Ben (Solutions Eng): for pricing numbers: i'll put three examples (POC light: $X/day vCPU + burst GPU; POC standard: reserved 2x A10s equivalent; Pilot: reserved capacity quote). needs finance signoff but good to have placeholders.

Rahul (SRE): Ops notes to include in RFI answers: expected SLA for Dedicated (99.9% uptime for provisioned pool), escalation path, logging/retention defaults, audit log options (30/90/365 days). i'll add a short note on network peering and egress estimates.

Ops Bot: Salesforce: New RFI thread created (Verdant Health) — link: https://salesforce.example/VERDANT-3112 (automated).

June (Sales): perfect. action items: Ben — capability matrix + perf CSV + network diagram (due EOD). Maria — quantization bullets + eval snippet + POC outline (due EOD). Rahul — KMS/HSM ops checklist + SLA bullets + audit retention options (due EOD). i'll assemble the written answers and send an initial draft to Verdant procurement. please react when uploaded. :thumbsup:

Ben (Solutions Eng): noted, uploading attachments now (perf-results.csv, net-diagram.png).

Maria (Product): uploading quantization-summary.md and sample-eval.json.

Rahul (SRE): uploaded hsm-checklist.md and sla-summary.txt.

June (Sales): received — i have everything to draft the RFI response. i'll ping legal for the sample MSA/POC statement after i send the reply. thanks team!

Ben (Solutions Eng): quick question — Verdant asked about model pinning and rollbacks in a POC. short answer: yes, we support model version pinning per route + canary rollouts with automatic fallback. add that to the capability matrix.

Maria (Product): added model pinning + canary rollback bullets to the matrix.

June (Sales): final: i'll send the RFI by noon PST tomorrow. if anything else comes up, flag it here.

Rahul (SRE): small follow-up: include a note about expected warmup tokens for KV cache on first-run traffic — can save them 20-40% on token cost for chat use cases.

June (Sales): good call — added. closing this thread once the RFI is out. :rocket:
